name: minutes_7d
definition: Total minutes listened in the 7 days before the cutoff.
rationale: Overall engagement; lower listening is associated with churn.
leakage_note: Daily logs dated strictly before the cutoff; the scoring-only March logs are never read.

name: active_days_7d
definition: Days with any listening in the last 7 days.
rationale: Habit strength, less sensitive to binge days than minutes.
leakage_note: Daily logs dated strictly before the cutoff; the scoring-only March logs are never read.

name: plays_7d
definition: Songs played (any completion level) in the last 7 days.
rationale: Engagement measured in plays rather than time.
leakage_note: Daily logs dated strictly before the cutoff; the scoring-only March logs are never read.

name: unique_songs_7d
definition: Sum of daily unique songs in the last 7 days.
rationale: Breadth of listening; narrow listening may signal lower attachment.
leakage_note: Daily logs dated strictly before the cutoff; the scoring-only March logs are never read.

name: minutes_ratio_7_23
definition: Minutes per day in the last 7 days / minutes per day in the 23 days before that. NULL if the earlier period has no listening.
rationale: A drop relative to the user's own recent level (e.g. 0.38 = down 62%).
leakage_note: Daily logs dated strictly before the cutoff; the scoring-only March logs are never read.

name: active_days_ratio_7_23
definition: Active-day rate in the last 7 days / rate in the 23 days before.
rationale: Change in habit frequency relative to the user's own baseline.
leakage_note: Daily logs dated strictly before the cutoff; the scoring-only March logs are never read.

name: minutes_ratio_30_60
definition: Minutes per day in the last 30 days / minutes per day in the 60 days before that. NULL if the earlier period has no listening.
rationale: A drop relative to the user's own recent level (e.g. 0.38 = down 62%).
leakage_note: Daily logs dated strictly before the cutoff; the scoring-only March logs are never read.

name: active_days_ratio_30_60
definition: Active-day rate in the last 30 days / rate in the 60 days before.
rationale: Change in habit frequency relative to the user's own baseline.
leakage_note: Daily logs dated strictly before the cutoff; the scoring-only March logs are never read.

name: minutes_slope_30d
definition: OLS slope of daily minutes (inactive days = 0) over the last 30 days, in minutes/day per day; positive = rising.
rationale: Direction of the listening trajectory, using every day rather than two periods.
leakage_note: Daily logs dated strictly before the cutoff; the scoring-only March logs are never read.

name: minutes_slope_90d
definition: OLS slope of daily minutes (inactive days = 0) over the last 90 days, in minutes/day per day; positive = rising.
rationale: Direction of the listening trajectory, using every day rather than two periods.
leakage_note: Daily logs dated strictly before the cutoff; the scoring-only March logs are never read.

name: minutes_cv_90d
definition: Coefficient of variation of daily minutes over 90 days (inactive days = 0). NULL if no listening.
rationale: Erratic listening may indicate a weaker routine.
leakage_note: Daily logs dated strictly before the cutoff; the scoring-only March logs are never read.

name: longest_inactive_gap_90d
definition: Longest run of consecutive days without listening in the last 90 days (including a run that reaches the cutoff).
rationale: Long breaks are associated with lapsing.
leakage_note: Daily logs dated strictly before the cutoff; the scoring-only March logs are never read.

name: days_since_last_listen
definition: Days from the last listening day to the cutoff; 91 if none in 90 days.
rationale: Recency of engagement (the R in RFM, unbinned).
leakage_note: Daily logs dated strictly before the cutoff; the scoring-only March logs are never read.

name: minutes_per_active_day_30d
definition: Minutes in the last 30 days / active days in the last 30 days.
rationale: Session depth on days the user does listen.
leakage_note: Daily logs dated strictly before the cutoff; the scoring-only March logs are never read.

name: capped_days_90d
definition: Days in the last 90 whose total_secs was capped at one day (Phase 1 rule L1).
rationale: Flags implausible logging that may distort minutes.
leakage_note: Daily logs dated strictly before the cutoff; the scoring-only March logs are never read.

name: skip_rate_30d
definition: Share of plays stopped before 25% of the song, last 30 days. NULL if no plays.
rationale: Frequent skipping can indicate poor content fit.
leakage_note: Daily logs dated strictly before the cutoff; the scoring-only March logs are never read.

name: completion_rate_30d
definition: Share of plays over 98.5% complete, last 30 days. NULL if no plays.
rationale: Full listens suggest content satisfaction.
leakage_note: Daily logs dated strictly before the cutoff; the scoring-only March logs are never read.

name: unique_song_share_30d
definition: Daily unique songs / plays, last 30 days. NULL if no plays.
rationale: Exploration vs repeat listening.
leakage_note: Daily logs dated strictly before the cutoff; the scoring-only March logs are never read.

name: skip_rate_90d
definition: Share of plays stopped before 25% of the song, last 90 days. NULL if no plays.
rationale: Frequent skipping can indicate poor content fit.
leakage_note: Daily logs dated strictly before the cutoff; the scoring-only March logs are never read.

name: completion_rate_90d
definition: Share of plays over 98.5% complete, last 90 days. NULL if no plays.
rationale: Full listens suggest content satisfaction.
leakage_note: Daily logs dated strictly before the cutoff; the scoring-only March logs are never read.

name: unique_song_share_90d
definition: Daily unique songs / plays, last 90 days. NULL if no plays.
rationale: Exploration vs repeat listening.
leakage_note: Daily logs dated strictly before the cutoff; the scoring-only March logs are never read.

name: skip_rate_change_30_60
definition: Skip rate in the last 30 days minus skip rate in days 31-90.
rationale: Rising skipping relative to the user's own baseline.
leakage_note: Daily logs dated strictly before the cutoff; the scoring-only March logs are never read.

name: completion_rate_change_30_60
definition: Completion rate in the last 30 days minus completion rate in days 31-90.
rationale: Falling satisfaction relative to the user's own baseline.
leakage_note: Daily logs dated strictly before the cutoff; the scoring-only March logs are never read.

name: last_plan_days
definition: payment_plan_days of the latest non-cancel transaction before the cutoff.
rationale: Plan length; short trial-like plans churn far more (Phase 3).
leakage_note: Uses only events dated strictly before the cutoff.

name: last_list_price
definition: plan_list_price (NTD) of the latest non-cancel transaction before the cutoff.
rationale: Price tier of the current plan.
leakage_note: Uses only events dated strictly before the cutoff.

name: last_amount_paid
definition: actual_amount_paid (NTD) of the latest non-cancel transaction before the cutoff.
rationale: What the user actually pays.
leakage_note: Uses only events dated strictly before the cutoff.

name: last_discount_amount
definition: plan_list_price - actual_amount_paid of the latest non-cancel transaction before the cutoff.
rationale: Size of any discount on the current plan.
leakage_note: Uses only events dated strictly before the cutoff.

name: last_price_per_day
definition: actual_amount_paid / payment_plan_days of the latest non-cancel transaction before the cutoff.
rationale: Normalises price across plan lengths.
leakage_note: Uses only events dated strictly before the cutoff.

name: last_is_discounted
definition: 1 if 0 < paid < list price on the latest non-cancel transaction before the cutoff.
rationale: Promotional pricing flag.
leakage_note: Uses only events dated strictly before the cutoff.

name: last_is_free
definition: 1 if amount paid is 0 on the latest non-cancel transaction before the cutoff.
rationale: Free periods are associated with much higher churn (Phase 3).
leakage_note: Uses only events dated strictly before the cutoff.

name: last_list_price_zero
definition: 1 if list price is 0 on the latest non-cancel transaction before the cutoff.
rationale: Zero-price plans (trials, bundles).
leakage_note: Uses only events dated strictly before the cutoff.

name: last_is_auto_renew
definition: is_auto_renew of the latest non-cancel transaction before the cutoff.
rationale: Strongest single association with churn in Phase 3 (V 0.38).
leakage_note: Uses only events dated strictly before the cutoff.

name: last_payment_method
definition: payment_method_id of the latest non-cancel transaction before the cutoff, as a category.
rationale: Payment channel; strongly associated with churn in Phase 3 (V 0.38).
leakage_note: Uses only events dated strictly before the cutoff.

name: last_txn_is_cancel
definition: 1 if the most recent pre-cutoff transaction of any kind is a cancellation.
rationale: An active cancellation before the cutoff.
leakage_note: Uses only events dated strictly before the cutoff.

name: days_to_expiry
definition: Latest membership_expire_date over non-cancel pre-cutoff transactions, minus the cutoff (days).
rationale: How soon the membership runs out.
leakage_note: Expiry dates are written on pre-cutoff transactions, but an export can restate them later. Mitigated by the v1_then_v2 source policy (Phase 1, decision #12).

name: days_to_latest_txn_expiry
definition: Expiry on the most recent pre-cutoff transaction (cancellations included), minus the cutoff.
rationale: Captures expiries moved earlier by a cancellation.
leakage_note: Expiry dates are written on pre-cutoff transactions, but an export can restate them later. Mitigated by the v1_then_v2 source policy (Phase 1, decision #12).

name: n_transactions_365d
definition: Non-cancel transactions in the last 365 days.
rationale: Payment activity.
leakage_note: Uses only events dated strictly before the cutoff.

name: total_paid_365d
definition: NTD paid (non-cancel) in the last 365 days.
rationale: Customer value to date.
leakage_note: Uses only events dated strictly before the cutoff.

name: share_auto_renew_365d
definition: Share of non-cancel transactions in the last 365 days with auto-renew.
rationale: Stability of the renewal habit.
leakage_note: Uses only events dated strictly before the cutoff.

name: n_plan_changes_365d
definition: Consecutive non-cancel transactions in the last 365 days whose plan length or list price differs from the previous one.
rationale: Plan switching (up/downgrades).
leakage_note: Uses only events dated strictly before the cutoff.

name: n_payment_method_changes_365d
definition: Consecutive non-cancel transactions in the last 365 days with a different payment method from the previous one.
rationale: Payment instability.
leakage_note: Uses only events dated strictly before the cutoff.

name: n_promo_txns_180d
definition: Non-cancel transactions in the last 180 days with list price 0 or paid below list.
rationale: Reliance on promotions.
leakage_note: Uses only events dated strictly before the cutoff.

name: n_cancels_all
definition: Cancellation transactions before the cutoff (history from 2015-01-01).
rationale: Past cancellations.
leakage_note: Uses only events dated strictly before the cutoff.

name: n_cancels_365d
definition: Cancellation transactions in the last 365 days.
rationale: Recent cancellations.
leakage_note: Uses only events dated strictly before the cutoff.

name: days_since_last_cancel
definition: Days since the latest pre-cutoff cancellation; NULL if none.
rationale: Recency of cancelling.
leakage_note: Uses only events dated strictly before the cutoff.

name: days_since_last_transaction
definition: Days since the latest pre-cutoff transaction of any kind.
rationale: Payment recency.
leakage_note: Uses only events dated strictly before the cutoff.

name: days_since_first_transaction
definition: Days since the earliest pre-cutoff transaction (left-censored: history starts 2015-01-01).
rationale: Length of observed paying history.
leakage_note: Uses only events dated strictly before the cutoff.

name: no_transaction_history
definition: 1 if the user has no pre-cutoff transaction at all.
rationale: Missing history is itself informative (Phase 3: 33.8% churn).
leakage_note: Uses only events dated strictly before the cutoff.

name: tenure_days
definition: Days from registration to the cutoff; NULL if unknown.
rationale: Longer-tenured users may be more committed.
leakage_note: members_v3 is one undated extract: attributes may have changed after the cutoff. Users who registered on/after the cutoff are treated exactly like users with no members row, so post-cutoff registration is not revealed.

name: registered_via
definition: Registration channel code.
rationale: Acquisition channel; associated with churn in Phase 3 (V 0.17).
leakage_note: members_v3 is one undated extract: attributes may have changed after the cutoff. Users who registered on/after the cutoff are treated exactly like users with no members row, so post-cutoff registration is not revealed.

name: member_info_missing
definition: 1 if no usable members row (none, or registered on/after the cutoff).
rationale: Missing profile information.
leakage_note: members_v3 is one undated extract: attributes may have changed after the cutoff. Users who registered on/after the cutoff are treated exactly like users with no members row, so post-cutoff registration is not revealed.

name: age
definition: Age in years if 10-90, else NULL (Phase 1 rule M1).
rationale: Built for the fairness audit.
leakage_note: members_v3 is one undated extract: attributes may have changed after the cutoff. Users who registered on/after the cutoff are treated exactly like users with no members row, so post-cutoff registration is not revealed.

name: gender
definition: male / female / unknown.
rationale: Built for the fairness audit.
leakage_note: members_v3 is one undated extract: attributes may have changed after the cutoff. Users who registered on/after the cutoff are treated exactly like users with no members row, so post-cutoff registration is not revealed.

name: city
definition: City code.
rationale: Built for the fairness audit; can act as a proxy for protected traits.
leakage_note: members_v3 is one undated extract: attributes may have changed after the cutoff. Users who registered on/after the cutoff are treated exactly like users with no members row, so post-cutoff registration is not revealed.

name: r_score
definition: RFM recency score 1-5 (Phase 4).
rationale: Binned recency on the reference scale.
leakage_note: Phase 4 scores use pre-cutoff snapshot data, with cut-points and clusters fitted on snapshot A only and applied unchanged to B.

name: f_score
definition: RFM frequency score 1-5.
rationale: Binned frequency.
leakage_note: Phase 4 scores use pre-cutoff snapshot data, with cut-points and clusters fitted on snapshot A only and applied unchanged to B.

name: m_score
definition: RFM monetary score 1-5.
rationale: Binned spend.
leakage_note: Phase 4 scores use pre-cutoff snapshot data, with cut-points and clusters fitted on snapshot A only and applied unchanged to B.

name: personal_recency
definition: Current gap / the user's own median gap between active days (needs 5+ active days).
rationale: Silence relative to the user's own routine.
leakage_note: Phase 4 scores use pre-cutoff snapshot data, with cut-points and clusters fitted on snapshot A only and applied unchanged to B.

name: rfm_segment
definition: Rule-based RFM segment (Phase 4).
rationale: Interpretable engagement segment.
leakage_note: Phase 4 scores use pre-cutoff snapshot data, with cut-points and clusters fitted on snapshot A only and applied unchanged to B.

name: rfm_group
definition: K-Means cluster for users who paid and listened; rule label otherwise.
rationale: Captures low-payment listeners (cluster 3: 15.2% churn).
leakage_note: Phase 4 scores use pre-cutoff snapshot data, with cut-points and clusters fitted on snapshot A only and applied unchanged to B.
